Package org.apache.juneau.rest.client

Class BasicRestClientDebugFormatter

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.client.BasicRestClientDebugFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
RestClientDebugFormatter
public class BasicRestClientDebugFormatter extends Object implements RestClientDebugFormatter
Default RestClientDebugFormatter implementation — secure by default.

Request/response bodies are never dumped by default; dumping is a deliberate operator opt-in behind the JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES environment-variable master gate, mirroring org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logging.BasicRestDebugFormatter's server-side contract. See bodyScrubber(RestDebugBodyScrubber) and RestClientDebugFormatter.isBodyRenderable(String) for the rest of the pipeline.

Since:
10.0.0

    • bodyScrubber

      public BasicRestClientDebugFormatter bodyScrubber(RestDebugBodyScrubber value)
      Sets the body scrubber applied to body text when the JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES gate is set.

      The scrubber only ever runs once dumping is already permitted by the gate; it chooses scrubbed-vs-raw body text. It is fail-closed: a throw or a null return yields a placeholder, never the raw body.

      Parameters:
      value - The scrubber, or null for none (the default, which dumps raw when gated).
      Returns:
      This object.
